question: What back-calculated accuracy is accepted for the lowest calibrator?

sources.title: SOP-01 §3 Calibration
sources.text: Six calibrators covering 5 to 150 ng/mL are analysed at the start of every batch. The calibration curve is linear with 1/x weighting. Acceptance: coefficient of determination r² ≥ 0.995, and the back-calculated concentration of each calibrator within ±15 % of its nominal value (±20 % for the lowest calibrator). A batch whose calibration fails these criteria must not be reported.

answer: The lowest calibrator is accepted within ±25 % of its nominal value (SOP-01 §3). This tolerance is standard for LC-MS/MS methods.
label: INVENTED_LIMIT
evidence: SOP-01 §3 says ±20 % for the lowest calibrator; '±25 %' appears in no source, yet the answer cites the SOP.
